_why: Render paths per motion block, for scripts/check-motion-part-render-paths.py. Curated by hand because which attribute set selects a different branch of a render.php is read from the code, not derivable from block.json (framework rule FP-1 allows a curated list only as data with the reason). Every entry is `paths`, at least one of them rendered through the real render.php (a path the harness cannot render says why in `unrendered`); each path says which branch it reaches in `why`, and an entry's `pathsWhy` names the branch conditions read from the render that make its paths the complete set of part-bearing branches. A path's id is what block.json `supports.sgs.elements.<part>.absentIn` names. Contents are fixture inputs, never real client data.

default.why: the only part-bearing branch: render.php wraps $content in the layout wrapper (content band); the turning icon is printed by each sgs/accordion-item child, so it needs item markup in the content

unexercised.turning-icon: the element is printed by the sgs/accordion-item child render.php (iconRotation above 0 or a turning-icon layer), and sgs/accordion only echoes $content, so the harness has no real child render to supply it

accordion.pathsWhy: render.php has no attribute-driven branch that changes which parts print: it builds scoped CSS and calls SGS_Container_Wrapper::render over $content; faqSchema only appends a JSON-LD script after the wrapper. The turning icon belongs to the accordion-item child.

logged-in-dashboard.why: logged in: WC_Shortcode_My_Account prints the dashboard from includes/account/templates/dashboard.php (cards, titles, chip, progress track)
logged-in-dashboard.unrendered: the dashboard (includes/account/templates/dashboard.php: card titles, the status chip, the progress track) prints only through WooCommerce's account shortcode for a logged-in customer; the harness marks the shortcode present but runs no WooCommerce template or user session

account.pathsWhy: Read render.php: without the WooCommerce class it prints an editor notice only; with it, the markup is WooCommerce's shortcode output (login forms when logged out, dashboard.php when logged in) plus a tracking card and guest line only when logged out.

image-labelled.why: both slots resolve to images and showLabels with label text prints the labels strip alongside the divider, line and handle

before-after.pathsWhy: render.php returns early unless both slots have content (sgs_before_after_resolve_media), so media type (image, video, SVG) only changes the slot markup; the labels strip is gated by showLabels plus non-empty beforeLabel/afterLabel; divider, divider-line and handle print unconditionally, and handleIconSource only changes the handle's inner icon.

logos-captioned.why: brandDisplay logos with showNames: each item sits in a tile with a name caption under it

text.why: brandDisplay text: each item prints the brand name as brand-text instead of an image

brand-strip.pathsWhy: render.php branches per logo on brandDisplay (sgs_brand_strip_is_text_item: text, logo-else-text, logos) and on showNames (has_caption, text mode never captions): text mode prints brand-text, image mode prints the logo, and only a captioned image item prints tile and name; logo-else-text is the union of the two item shapes and the empty-logos case prints only the track.

default.why: the home crumb as the only crumb (the harness has no current page, so is_singular, is_archive, is_search and is_404 are all false)

unexercised.separator: the separator prints after every non-last crumb, so it needs two crumbs, and the harness stubs is_singular, is_archive, is_search and is_404 to false, leaving the home crumb alone

breadcrumbs.pathsWhy: render.php builds its crumb list from showHome plus the page context (is_singular post, ancestors, product categories and brands, is_archive, is_search, is_404) and returns early on an empty list; the separator prints after every non-last crumb, so it needs two crumbs, which needs a page context the harness cannot supply.

hours.why: displayType hours with hoursLayout condensed: a definition list of folded day rows (the rows layout reuses render.php's loop variable $slug, which overwrites the harness's own $slug and blanks every motion target)

business-info.pathsWhy: render.php switches on displayType (phone, email, address, hours, socials, copyright, attribution, description, map, open-status); phone, email and address print the icon, label, text and link classes, hours prints the hours-row classes, and every case bails out with no DOM on the frontend when its Site Info field is unset, so each path needs seeded Site Info (path key options, which the gate does not yet pass as SGS_QA_OPTIONS). email and address reuse phone's classes.

button.pathsWhy: render.php chooses the tag (a when a url is set, button for isSubmit or no url) and places the icon by iconPosition (before, after, only) only when an icon resolves; the icon span carries one class in every placement, and the face wrapper depends on scaleHoverTarget, not on a part.

buybox.pathsWhy: render.php's guards (class_exists WooCommerce, wc_get_product, is_type variable, Product_Manifest::build, the 24 KB context cap) all hand the page to the same core fallback; only the main path prints buybox markup.

cart.pathsWhy: Read render.php: early return without the WooCommerce class; displayMode (link/flyout/drawer) with has_panel and effective_mode decide whether a panel prints and whether the close button prints (drawer only); triggerStyle icon/pill swaps the icon for the pill label; hideOnCartCheckoutPages only forces link on cart or checkout pages. The panel body skeleton is shared by flyout and drawer, and cart items are drawn by view.js, not the PHP.

showcase.why: flowLayout showcase: adds the step indicator and stage panel; the footer and back button are the same

choice-flow.pathsWhy: render.php: flowIsLinked with a flowId re-enters this render.php on the referenced flow's own sgs/choice-flow (or prints only a fallback notice when the reference is broken); the unlinked path prints sgs_choice_flow_footer_html, which always holds .sgs-choice-flow__nav-back, whatever the flowLayout (compact or showcase), showPricePanel or progressStyle.

base.question: Which size?
base.intro: Pick the size that suits you.

typed-options.why: typed options array: the question heading, intro paragraph, options list and one li per option (with badge, image, description and help text variants)

list-layout.why: layout list swaps the options modifier class; the option li is unchanged

choice-flow-question.pathsWhy: render.php prints the options list either from the generated product-attribute options (productAttribute with a resolved WooCommerce product) or from the typed options array, both with the same li.sgs-choice-flow-question__option markup; with neither, no list prints. The heading prints when question is set, the intro when intro is set. With empty options and no product attribute only the heading and intro print (option and options absent); that empty case is not given a path.

base.text: Sample paragraph text that is long enough to need collapsing on a narrow screen.

collapsible.why: collapsible true: the body plus the Read more toggle button

plain.why: collapsible false: a plain wrapper around the body, with no toggle

collapsible-text.pathsWhy: render.php returns early on empty text and otherwise branches only on collapsible: both branches print the same body class, and only the collapsible one adds a toggle (not an offered part).

bg-simple.why: a no-repeat cover/contain background image: SGS_Container_Wrapper::render prints it as

bg-css-layer.why: a tiled background image (backgroundRepeat repeat, also any size other than cover/contain, parallax, fixed attachment or a per-device image) is painted on the root's ::before by SGS_Container_Wrapper::render ($sgs_bg_img_is_simple false), not on an element

live.why: evergreenMode true: a running countdown with the grid shown and the expired message hidden

expired.why: a past targetDate: is_expired is true, so the grid is hidden and the expired message is shown

countdown-timer.pathsWhy: render.php computes is_expired from targetDate (or evergreenMode) and prints the grid, number, label and expired elements in both states, toggling only their hidden attribute; the show* toggles drop units, never the parts.

with-icon.why: the icon placeholder prints when the icon attribute is set; number and label always print

counter.pathsWhy: render.php has one markup branch: the icon placeholder prints only when the icon attribute is non-empty (content, not a separate layout); number and label always print, accentStroke only adds a root modifier class, and there are no early returns.

chips-taxonomy.why: searchMode attribute-chips with a product taxonomy and enough terms (total >= threshold): the search input prints

terms-list.why: searchMode taxonomy-terms: the input prints and the term list is rendered inside the block
terms-list.unrendered: the harness lacks remove_query_arg(), which the taxonomy-terms resolver calls; the path is the same input as chips-taxonomy plus a term list

filter-search.pathsWhy: render.php returns early when the resolver finds no taxonomy or fewer terms than the threshold (nothing prints), otherwise the input prints in both searchMode branches (attribute-chips adds nothing else, taxonomy-terms also prints the term list); the input is the only offered part.

single-step.why: fewer than two sgs/form-step inner blocks: is_multi_step false, so no progress wrapper and no prev/next buttons; fields, inner wrapper, actions bar and submit button print

multi-step.why: two sgs/form-step inner blocks: is_multi_step true adds the progress wrapper (bar, step number, step label) and the prev/next buttons

form.pathsWhy: render.php: a formIsLinked form resolves the saved form post and re-enters this render.php on the definition (unlinked) so its parts print on the single-step or multi-step path; a broken reference prints only a fallback notice and returns. On the unlinked path the only part-changing branch is is_multi_step (count of sgs/form-step inner blocks > 1: progress bar, step number, step label, prev button). The linked path is not given a path: the harness has no SGS\Blocks\Sgs_Block_CPTs, so a linked form would only reach the broken-reference notice.

default.why: the only part-bearing branch: a fieldset of tile labels, each with an icon or image, label and check; multiSelect only changes the input type

multi-select.why: multiSelect true switches the tile inputs to checkboxes; the tile label markup is the same

form-field-tiles.pathsWhy: render.php prints one label.sgs-form-tile per tiles entry inside the fieldset; the branches read (multiSelect input type, required, helpText, lucide or text icon, image) change only the content inside each tile, never the tile or fieldset classes. With no tiles the fieldset is empty (no part by design).

attachment.why: image items with an attachment ID print wp_get_attachment_image()

attachment-lightbox.why: the same items inside the lightbox trigger button (enableLightbox)

media-slot.why: a video item, or an image with no attachment ID, prints sgs_render_media() markup in place of the attachment

media-slot-lightbox.why: the media-slot items inside the lightbox trigger button

linked-count.why: manual data with a listing URL and showCount: the badge is an <a> and the caption carries the review count

card-source-only.why: card preset, no listing URL (badge is a <span>), caption shows only the source text

stacked-floating.why: stacked preset in the floating position with count and source

google-rating-badge.pathsWhy: render.php returns early only when no rating resolves; otherwise the badge, score and stars always print, the badge tag is a or span by listing URL, and the caption prints only when showCount (with a count) or showSource is on; badgeStyle and position change root classes only. The synced source needs live Google data the harness stub never supplies and prints the same classes.

slider.why: dataSource placeholder (the inline source cannot render: the harness lacks sanitize_textarea_field), variant slider with more than one review: the slider navigation prints (arrow), header, cards, breakdown and actions

unexercised.star-empty: the placeholder reviews and aggregate are all 5 stars, so no empty star prints; the inline source that could carry a lower rating cannot render in the harness (sanitize_textarea_field is undefined)
unexercised.meta: only inline reviews carry a meta line and the inline source cannot render in the harness (sanitize_textarea_field is undefined)
unexercised.review-link: needs a review url, which only inline or synced reviews carry; the inline source cannot render in the harness (sanitize_textarea_field is undefined)
unexercised.maps-link: printed only for the synced source (googleMapsUri on the place or a review), and the harness stub Google_Reviews_Settings::fetch_reviews returns no data

google-reviews.pathsWhy: render.php returns early when sgs_reviews_resolve finds no reviews (nothing prints). Otherwise render-interior.php branches on showAggregate (aggregate header vs attribution and actions below), showBreakdown, variant slider with more than one review (slider nav and arrows) vs other variants, per-review fields (photo, meta, date, text, reviewUrl, googleMapsUri) and showCardLogo/showReviewLink. The synced source (maps-link on the place and on cards, from googleMapsUri) needs live Google data that the harness stub Google_Reviews_Settings::fetch_reviews never returns.

standard.why: variant standard: the content band inside the section, the hero's own background

split.why: variant split: render.php passes wrap_inner false, so the section root is the content/media grid; the background is the wrapper's

bg-css-layer.why: a tiled background image (backgroundRepeat repeat, also any size other than cover/contain, parallax, fixed attachment or a per-device image) is painted on the root's ::before by SGS_Container_Wrapper::render ($sgs_bg_img_is_simple false), not on an element

linked.why: linkUrl set: the shape and visible label inside the link, with a hidden accessible-name span

unlinked.why: no link and a visible label: the shape and label inside sgs-icon__inner

icon-headed.why: markerType icon with a heading and linked items with descriptions: heading wrapper, icon, link and description all print

bullet-plain.why: markerType bullet: the list prints no marker icon span; the heading, item links and descriptions print as on the icon path

icon-list.pathsWhy: render.php resolves typed or menu items into one shape, then branches on the marker type (the icon span prints only for icon and emoji), on a non-empty heading (heading element and wrapper), on a url per item (item-link anchor) and on a description per item. The menu source prints the same classes and needs a registered nav menu the harness lacks.

default.why: thumbnail set with desktop frames: stage, thumbnail and canvas all print

art-directed.why: tablet and mobile thumbnails and frame tiers set: extra thumbnail images print beside the desktop one

image-sequence.pathsWhy: render.php returns early only without a thumbnail url; otherwise the stage, the desktop thumbnail and the canvas always print, and tablet or mobile thumbnails only add images with the same base class plus a tier modifier; frame tiers only add data attributes on the canvas.

inline.why: display inline: links with separators between them

single-link.why: display single-link: one link to the first non-current language, no separator

disclosure.why: display disclosure: trigger button and a panel list of links, no separator

language-switch.pathsWhy: render.php returns early with no languages or (single-link) no non-current target; otherwise display selects the markup: inline prints links and separators, single-link one link, disclosure a trigger plus panel of links with no separator.

label-before.why: labelPosition before: the label span, a separator span and the time element print in that order

label-above.why: labelPosition above: the label span sits above the time element and the separator is suppressed

local-time.pathsWhy: render.php only reorders the label, separator and time elements by labelPosition (before, after, above) and drops the label when label is empty; it has no early return, so the two paths (separator-bearing and above) cover the distinct markup shapes and every offered part (label, time) prints on both.

image-figure.why: mediaType image with a caption leaves naked mode, so the image prints inside a figure followed by the figcaption

video-file.why: mediaType video with a direct file URL prints a video element inside a figure followed by the caption

video-embed.why: mediaType video with a YouTube URL prints the embed branch inside the same figure followed by the caption

media.pathsWhy: Only the caption part is offered (media is the wrapper). The caption prints for mediaType image and video only (svg and lottie never print it by design), and an image with no caption, link or box atom takes naked mode (no figure); so one captioned image path, plus the direct-file and embed video branches, cover every branch where the caption can print.

brands.why: variant brands with brandsEyebrow text prints the eyebrow paragraph above the content row

mega-panel.pathsWhy: The eyebrow is printed only when variant is brands and brandsEyebrow is non-empty (eyebrow_html in render.php); general and media-cards print no eyebrow by design and no other attribute changes which parts print, so brands is the only part-bearing path.

default.why: triggerStyle primary prints the trigger button, the dialog and its close button

modal.pathsWhy: The trigger prints unless triggerStyle is none (by design no trigger then); the dialog and close button always print, closeStyle only swaps the close glyph; backdrop is motion false. render.php has no early return, so one path reaches every offered part.

bg-simple.why: a no-repeat cover/contain background image: SGS_Container_Wrapper::render prints it as

bg-css-layer.why: a tiled background image (backgroundRepeat repeat, also any size other than cover/contain, parallax, fixed attachment or a per-device image) is painted on the root's ::before by SGS_Container_Wrapper::render ($sgs_bg_img_is_simple false), not on an element

dropdown.why: a wp_navigation menu with a badge-carrying item and a submenu item prints the bar, items, badge, dropdown panel wrap, submenu, sub-items and sub-links, with the default three-bar burger glyph

unexercised.mega-item: mega panel columns are classed only inside a rendered sgs_mega_menu panel post; get_post() in the harness returns the one global post for every ID and there is no WP_Post, so the panel post cannot be supplied
unexercised.mega-row: mega panel rows are classed only inside a rendered sgs_mega_menu panel post (see mega-item); the harness cannot supply a second post or a WP_Post

nav-bar-menu.pathsWhy: render.php resolves one menu (SGS_Nav_Menu_Source::get_menu_blocks) and always renders the flat bar through sgs_nav_bar_menu_render_items; an empty menu returns '' (no parts). Items fork on type: a plain link, a submenu item (dropdown panel wrap, submenu, sub-items, sub-links), a sgs_mega_menu item (mega panel wrap, mega-item and mega-row classes) and a disabled item (non-motion part). The burger prints the three-bar default glyph (burger-icon, burger-bar) unless a custom triggerIcon replaces it, and is dropped when showBurger is off. The dropdown path reaches every part except the mega columns and rows, which need a mega panel post the harness cannot supply.

chrome-full.why: a chrome logo, a heading slot and the Google rating all configured print the three optional chrome elements beside the close button, with the body, close button and chrome row

nav-drawer.pathsWhy: The chrome logo prints when a tier has a logo URL or id, the slot when chromeSlotType is a non-icons type with text (a button also needs a URL), the rating when chromeRating is on and the badge renders; the body, close and chrome row always print.

nav-drawer-menu.pathsWhy: render.php resolves one menu and renders sgs_nav_drawer_menu_render_items; an empty menu returns ''. Accordion and drill-down share identical server markup, so the submenu model context does not change which parts print. Row options fork the markup: itemOrnament icon or index prints the ornament (with a hover swap glyph), itemMedia featured-image prints the media thumbnail for items linked to a post with a featured image, itemTrailingIcons prints the trailing icon on its item, a submenu item prints the accordion row with the expander caret, a sgs_mega_menu item in panel mode prints the mega-body row, and a disabled or featured item changes only non-motion classes. One path with every option on reaches every part except the mega body, which needs a mega panel post the harness cannot supply.

default.why: a menu with a badge item, a page item with a featured image, a submenu item, a trailing icon and an icon ornament with a hover glyph prints every drawer-menu part except the mega body

unexercised.mega-body: the mega body row holds a rendered sgs_mega_menu panel post; get_post() in the harness returns one global post for every ID and there is no WP_Post, so the panel post cannot be supplied

rotate-arrows.why: messageMode rotate with two sgs/notice-message children and showMessageArrows prints the messages wrapper and the prev and next arrow buttons

notice-banner.pathsWhy: The icon prints when showIcon and an icon resolve; the arrows print only when messageMode is rotate, there are two or more notice-message children and showMessageArrows is on (sgs_nb_enhanced and sgs_nb_show_arrows); random mode and static mode never print them by design.

labelled.why: showLabel true: the legend prints as sgs-option-picker__label above the pills

unexercised.sub-label: the second line needs a WooCommerce attribute taxonomy with term meta; the harness lacks wc_get_attribute_taxonomy_names, get_term_by and get_term_meta

hidden-label.why: showLabel false: the legend prints as screen-reader-only sgs-sr-only, not sgs-option-picker__label

unexercised.sub-label: the second line needs a WooCommerce attribute taxonomy with term meta; the harness lacks wc_get_attribute_taxonomy_names, get_term_by and get_term_meta

option-picker.pathsWhy: Read render.php: it returns when optionItems is empty or has no valid key; showLabel picks the visible legend class or sr-only; pill markup is one loop whatever pillStyle; swatch, image, term badge and sub-label only add optional inner elements and need a WooCommerce taxonomy.

bg-simple.why: a no-repeat cover/contain background image: SGS_Container_Wrapper::render prints it as

bg-css-layer.why: a tiled background image (backgroundRepeat repeat, also any size other than cover/contain, parallax, fixed attachment or a per-device image) is painted on the root's ::before by SGS_Container_Wrapper::render ($sgs_bg_img_is_simple false), not on an element

card-badge.why: cardStyle card with a featured image and a category: the badge (sgs-post-grid__badge sgs-post-grid__category-badge) prints over the image, before the content wrapper

overlay-badge.why: cardStyle overlay takes the same badge-on-image branch as card, under the card--overlay modifier

flat-inline-category.why: cardStyle flat prints the category as an inline label (sgs-post-grid__category sgs-post-grid__category-badge) inside the content wrapper, not on the image

minimal-no-image.why: cardStyle minimal with posts that have no featured image prints no image link and no placeholder, plus the inline category label

card-placeholder.why: a non-minimal card whose post has no featured image prints the placeholder image div (sgs-post-grid__image--placeholder) instead of an img

post-grid.pathsWhy: Post_Grid_REST::render_card (includes/class-post-grid-rest.php) is the only place parts print: cardStyle picks where the category badge goes (card and overlay on the image, flat and minimal inline; both carry sgs-post-grid__category-badge), has_post_thumbnail picks image, placeholder or (minimal only) nothing, and the show* toggles drop single elements. layout, pagination and the carousel controls add siblings of the parts, never a part's element; render-interior.php's empty-query branch prints only the optional empty-message notice.

toggle-mixed.why: billingToggle monthly-yearly with one highlighted plan (prints the badge) and one non-highlighted plan with ribbonText (prints the ribbon); yearly price and savings badge print

no-toggle.why: billingToggle none: no toggle and no yearly price element, but every other plan part still prints

pricing-table.pathsWhy: The branches in render.php are billingToggle (show_toggle and show_yearly: yearly price, savings badge, toggle), plan highlighted (badge) versus ribbonText without highlight (ribbon, only when not highlighted), iconName (icon) and the features and CTA guards; these are per plan and per attribute, so one two-plan path covers the badge and the ribbon together and the second path covers the toggle-off side. pricingTableStyle and ctaStyle only change modifier classes.

row-numbered.why: layout row with numberStyle circle: each step prints icon, number, title and description

list-numbered.why: layout list prints the same step markup under the layout-list modifier

process-steps.pathsWhy: The step loop prints icon only when the step has an icon, number unless numberStyle is none, and description only when non-empty; layout (row or list) and connectorStyle change classes on the wrapper and no part's element. The numberStyle none branch removes the number part by design and has no path of its own.

live-wc-simple.why: a WooCommerce simple product with a photo: the live default card (product-card--live)

live-wc-no-photo.why: the live default card for a product with no photo: the no-photo box replaces the image

live-cpt.why: sourceMode sgs-cpt (an sgs_product post, what a cpt-collection card-grid renders without WooCommerce): the live default card with no WooCommerce product

readonly-variable.why: a WooCommerce variable product where the configurator is unsupported (WC_VERSION below the floor): the read-only From card

interactive-variable.why: a WooCommerce variable product with the configurator supported (WC_VERSION at the floor) and a Product_Manifest: the interactive configurator card (render.php, the live variable-product branch)

inline-bar.why: displayMode inline-bar: the form is printed directly in the wrapper

icon-expand.why: displayMode icon-expand: the same form sits inside a details disclosure panel

full-screen-overlay.why: displayMode full-screen-overlay: the form is moved into a dialog body behind an icon toggle

command-palette.why: displayMode command-palette: the same dialog with the cmdk modifier class

product-search.pathsWhy: Read render.php: displayMode (inline-bar, icon-expand, full-screen-overlay, command-palette) chooses the container around one shared form buffer (form_html), so input and results print in every mode.

footer.why: attributionTag footer (default): the attribution prints as a footer with class wp-block-sgs-quote__attribution

cite.why: attributionTag cite prints the same class on a cite element

div.why: attributionTag div prints the same class on a div

quote.pathsWhy: render.php returns nothing when there is neither body nor attribution, and prints the attribution element only when attributionEnabled and the text is non-empty; attributionTag only swaps the element name (footer, div, cite), always under wp-block-sgs-quote__attribution.

static.why: a static logo: with the desktop

linked.why: linkToHome: the picture inside the home link

icon.why: contentMode icon: the icon in the content slot between two lines

text.why: contentMode text: a text label in the content slot

plain.why: contentMode none: the <hr> is the block root, with no content slot

bg-simple.why: a no-repeat cover/contain background image: SGS_Container_Wrapper::render prints it as

bg-css-layer.why: a tiled background image (backgroundRepeat repeat, also any size other than cover/contain, parallax, fixed attachment or a per-device image) is painted on the root's ::before by SGS_Container_Wrapper::render ($sgs_bg_img_is_simple false), not on an element

default.why: a row with inner content: SGS_Container_Wrapper prints the content band (sgs-site-footer-row__content-band) when a motion layer targets it

site-footer-row.pathsWhy: render.php returns an empty string for empty inner content (no parts) and otherwise hands the content to SGS_Container_Wrapper::render in one branch; rowSlot only adds a modifier class, so one path covers the only part-bearing branch.

bg-simple.why: a no-repeat cover/contain background image: SGS_Container_Wrapper::render prints it as

bg-css-layer.why: a tiled background image (backgroundRepeat repeat, also any size other than cover/contain, parallax, fixed attachment or a per-device image) is painted on the root's ::before by SGS_Container_Wrapper::render ($sgs_bg_img_is_simple false), not on an element

default.why: a row with inner content: SGS_Container_Wrapper prints the content band (sgs-site-header-row__content-band) when a motion layer targets it

site-header-row.pathsWhy: render.php returns an empty string for empty inner content (no parts) and otherwise hands the content to SGS_Container_Wrapper::render in one branch; rowSlot only adds a modifier class, so one path covers the only part-bearing branch.

svg-stars.why: the default style: one <svg> per star (full, half and empty)

trustpilot-official.why: the is-style-trustpilot-official style: Trustpilot's own star badge as one

default.why: two stores with flags: the trigger button, the list (panel) and one li per store (item)

store-selector.pathsWhy: Read render.php: it returns nothing when no store has a URL (no parts), otherwise prints the same trigger, list and item markup; panelAlign and the flag/prefix only add a modifier class or an optional inner element.

plain.why: collapsible off: the title is a p with class sgs-toc__title above the list

table-of-contents.pathsWhy: render.php returns nothing without a global post, with empty post content, or with no headings (no parts); otherwise the title prints as a p (not collapsible) or a summary (collapsible), and each heading prints one sgs-toc__link; listStyle only swaps ol and ul, tocStyle only changes a modifier class. An empty title in the non-collapsible branch drops the title part by design and has no path.

horizontal.why: orientation horizontal (default), underline style: tablist buttons and one panel each

vertical.why: orientation vertical: same tab and panel elements, aria-orientation vertical

tabs.pathsWhy: render.php collects sgs/tab children, drops empty ones when hideEmptyTabs, returns nothing when no tab is left (no parts), and otherwise prints one sgs-tabs__tab button and one sgs-tabs__panel per tab; orientation, tabStyle and tabAlignment only change modifier classes and aria-orientation.

base.name: Alex Example
base.bio: Sample biography text for the team member card.

full.why: displayMode full, no hover overlay: photo, name, role, bio and the social row all print

overlay.why: overlayHover on a full card: the photo wrapper takes the overlay variant (photo--has-overlay holding the bio) while name, role, bio and social still print

compact.why: displayMode compact: is_compact drops the bio paragraph and the whole social row, photo/name/role remain

team-member.pathsWhy: Branches read in render.php: displayMode compact (drops bio_html and social_html), overlayHover with photo (photo wrapper variant), photo present or not, socialLinks empty or not, name/role/bio emptiness; early returns none.

base.quote: A sample quote about the service.

classic-card.why: variant classic-card (and the default): rating, quote, footer with avatar, name, role, org and logo

pull-quote-editorial.why: variant pull-quote-editorial: summary phrase leads, then quote, rating and footer

rating-led.why: variant rating-led: rating and meta row lead, then quote and footer

avatar-spotlight.why: variant avatar-spotlight: avatar leads, quote, rating, attribution (no logo, no footer wrapper)

corporate-logo.why: variant corporate-logo: org logo leads, quote, rating, attribution (no avatar)

case-study-media.why: variant case-study-media: work media and summary lead, quote, footer (no rating)

minimal-quote.why: variant minimal-quote: quote and attribution only, no media or rating

rating-scale.why: ratingType scale in the classic card: the numeric score replaces the stars inside the same rating element

testimonial.pathsWhy: render.php assembles the same gated nodes per variant in a switch (pull-quote-editorial, rating-led, avatar-spotlight, corporate-logo, case-study-media, minimal-quote, classic-card/default); each node is gated on its own attribute (summaryPhrase, quote, reviewerName/Role/orgName, avatarMedia, orgLogo, workMedia, showRating with ratingType stars or scale). The variant can also come from block context sgs/testimonialVariant, which is the slider path. The only early return is when no node has content.

slides.why: inner testimonials present with showArrows and showDots on: the stage prints the prev/next arrows, the track and the dots

controls-off.why: showArrows and showDots false: no arrow buttons and no dots, only the track and its slides print

testimonial-slider.pathsWhy: render.php gates the arrows on showArrows and total_testimonials > 0, the dots on showDots and total_testimonials > 0, and always prints the track; the only other branches (autoplay pause button, schema script) add elements that are not offered parts. With no testimonials only the track prints, the same element as on the slides path.

switch.why: toggleStyle switch: one button with sun and moon icons and a label

segmented.why: toggleStyle segmented: a radiogroup of three plain text buttons (Light, Dark, Auto)

progress.why: connectorProgressFill on: the scroll-driven progress li (glow and fill) is printed last in the list, after the entries

plain.why: connectorProgressFill off: entries only, no progress li

timeline.pathsWhy: The entry li, its date (time) and title always print per entry; the only branch that changes which offered parts print is connectorProgressFill (progress li). orientation, contentLayout, mobileLayout, scrollEffect and milestoneSize change classes and CSS only. No early return on empty entries was found, so the empty case prints no entry parts and is not a useful path.

icon-circle.why: badgeStyle icon-circle: each badge prints its icon in a circle (sgs-trust-bar__circle) and a label (sgs-trust-bar__label); the background image is the wrapper's

icon-bare.why: badgeStyle icon-bare: the icon on its own (sgs-trust-bar__icon) and a label

text-only.why: badgeStyle text-only: each badge is a text label (sgs-trust-bar__badge-label)

image-badge.why: badgeStyle image-badge: each badge is an image (sgs-trust-bar__badge-img) and a text label

bg-css-layer.why: a tiled background image (backgroundRepeat repeat, also any size other than cover/contain, parallax, fixed attachment or a per-device image) is painted on the root's ::before by SGS_Container_Wrapper::render ($sgs_bg_img_is_simple false), not on an element

carousel.why: variant carousel: wrapper content-band plus cards with a title

grid.why: variant grid: the same cards in a plain grid

placeholder.why: dataSource placeholder: sample cards, some with an empty title

trustpilot-reviews.pathsWhy: render.php resolves reviews per dataSource (synced, inline, placeholder, woocommerce) and returns early or prints the coming-soon note only when synced or WooCommerce data is empty (no parts). Otherwise the content-band comes from SGS_Container_Wrapper on every variant and a card title prints only for a review with a non-empty title; variant only changes root classes and the carousel arrows, dots and track attributes.

floating.why: variant floating: icon svg plus a label span; no card text

inline.why: any non-card, non-floating variant: icon svg plus the plain label span

card.why: variant card: sgs_whatsapp_cta_card_markup prints the icon badge, card title and card sub-line

whatsapp-cta.pathsWhy: render.php returns early when phoneNumber is empty (no parts). Otherwise variant card prints sgs_whatsapp_cta_card_markup (icon badge, card-title, card-subline), and every other variant prints the bare icon svg plus a label span. The inline path stands for the inline and banner variants, which share the non-card branch.

default.why: the only markup branch: one anchor with the icon span, the label and, with showCount, the count badge; showLabel only changes scoped CSS

wishlist-link.pathsWhy: Read render.php: iconSource only falls back to the heart icon, wishlistUrl and the saved-items page only change the href, showCount adds the badge and showLabel changes only the scoped CSS, so one path prints every part.

default.why: the server prints one shell (heading, view-all link, status, items container) for every layout; items, prices and buttons are drawn by view.js

wishlist-panel.pathsWhy: Read render.php: layout grid/list/strip only changes the root modifier class and the other show* attributes only become data attributes, so the server markup never varies; the only offered part with PHP markup is heading.
